title: VOL 9 — Test 4 (Reading + Listening)
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

parts.title: Denford Festival
parts.body:
What is the main attraction in each of the following areas of the festival?
Choose FIVE correct answers, A-G, next to questions 11-15.
Attractions
A talks about gardening
B live music
C an art exhibition
D a children's playground
E evening entertainment
F a competition for adults
G vegetable market

Areas of the festival
Bridge Street 11_____________
King's Park 12_____________
Oakvale School 13_____________
Green Road 14_____________
Sun Lane 15_____________

Choose the correct answer.
Denford Festival
16 What does Sam say about the festival tickets?
They allow you to get into all the festival events.
They are more expensive to buy on the day.
They have nearly all been sold.
17 On the last night of the festival, visitors will be able to
take part in a dance.
go to a theatre performance.
watch some fireworks.
18 What will be provided for international visitors?
discounts on accommodation.
tours of the local area.
a guide written in different languages.
19 What information is given about car park A?
It is bigger than car park B.
It is closer to town than car park B.
It will close earlier than car park B.
20 What change have the organisers made to the programme this year?
replacing the programme with an app
reducing the number of programmes printed
introducing a charge for the programmes

parts.title: Digital Technology and Theorists
parts.body:
What impact does Marc Prensky believe that digital technology has had on young people?
It has altered their thinking patterns.
It has harmed their physical development.
It has limited their brain capacity.

Digital immigrants tend to access computers
using their native language.
less efficiently than young people.
for less important information.

What example is given of having a 'digital accent'?
having less effective typing skills
doing things the old-fashioned way
being unable to understand instructions

Which theorist makes each of the following points?
Choose the correct letter, A, B or C, next to questions 34-40.
Theorists
A Allen
B James
C Vander
Points made
34 Current teaching methods don't work.
35 Many students don't understand computers.
36 Computer technology doesn't interest all students.
37 Students can still learn the traditional way.
38 Students still need to learn research skills.
39 We should use computer games to teach.
40 Computers can't replace educators.
